title: 65 Pond Cypress Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 65 Pond Cypress Circle is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12) 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental 6-Seater Electric Cart Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Natural Gas Grill Outdoor Fire Pit Exterior Shower Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Camp District 3 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor 5 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 5 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Nestled in the heart of WaterColor's Camp District, 65 Pond Cypress Circle is a stunning coastal retreat, professionally designed and decorated to create an atmosphere of sophisticated comfort and timeless style. This 3,100+ sq. ft. residence showcases exquisite craftsmanship, high-end finishes, and a seamless blend of luxury and livability—offering the perfect setting for an unforgettable 30A getaway. Step inside to find hand-selected hardwood floors and dramatic vaulted and beamed ceilings, enhancing the home's airy, light-filled interiors. Classic coastal shiplap walls add warmth and character, while the open-concept layout seamlessly connects the gourmet kitchen, dining, and living areas, making it ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. With culinary enthusiasts in mind, the chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and an oversized breakfast bar, perfect for casual gatherings. Multiple screened-in porches extend the living space outdoors, providing peaceful spots to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening breeze. The thoughtfully curated outdoor living area is just as impressive, featuring a private pool, outdoor fire pit, and natural gas grill, making it the perfect space to soak in the relaxed WaterColor lifestyle. An outdoor shower adds convenience after a day at the beach, and with six adult bikes included, guests can explore WaterColor and nearby Seaside with ease. Designed for both comfort and style, this home offers four beautifully appointed bedrooms plus a bonus living area, ensuring plenty of space for everyone. The first-floor primary suite is a sanctuary of relaxation, complete with a king bed, private porch access, and a spa-like ensuite featuring a soaking tub, steam tile shower, and dual vanities. Upstairs, additional guest suites provide luxurious accommodations, with plush bedding, private bathrooms, and a secondary lounge area equipped with built-in bunk beds. With Camp WaterColor just a 3-minute walk away and the WaterColor Beach Club only a 5-minute bike ride, this home offers unparalleled access to world-class amenities, including resort-style pools, private beach access, dining, shopping, and more. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, 65 Pond Cypress Circle delivers the perfect balance of coastal elegance and convenience. Book your stay with Sanders Beach Rentals, and let our dedicated team ensure a seamless, unforgettable 30A vacation.
